content.title: Rose Byrne Makes a Quick Change During Date Night With Bobby Cannavale for Oscars Vanity Fair Party
content.text: All the things you've done to your faces are very tasteful. TheBridesmaids' Kristen Wiig, Maya Rudolph and More Reunite at Oscars 2026—And Yes, It's a Party0 seconds of 1 minute, 10 secondsVolume 0%Bridesmaids' Kristen Wiig, Maya Rudolph and More Reunite at Oscars 2026—And Yes, It's a PartyRose Byrne is kicking up her legs after the Oscars 2026. After all, the If I Had Legs I'd Kick You star—who was nominated for Best Actress in a Leading Role on March 15, facing off against Bugonia's Emma Stone, Song Sung Blue's Kate Hudson, Hamnet's Jessie Buckley and Sentimental Value's Renate Reinsve—turned the evening into a date night with Bobby Cannavale. While arriving to Conan O'Brien-hosted award show held at the Dolby Theatre in Hollywood, the 46-year-old rocked a strapless Dior gown with a floral design and Taffin Desert jewelry as she and Bobby made their way down the red carpet. And after the show, she made a stylish quick-change, attending the Vanity Fair after-party in a two-piece black fringe set, also by Dior, as well Nikos Koulis Desert jewelry to keep the party going with Bobby by her side. This was Rose's first Academy Award nomination. However, she did recently win the Golden Globe for Best Female Actor in Musical/Comedy Motion Picture for her performance as Linda, an exhausted therapist struggling to care for her newborn baby girl."This is such a shock," she said in her acceptance speech at the time. "Thank you for believing in me and giving me this opportunity." In fact, Rose was so sure she wouldn't win that she was fine letting her longtime partner Bobby skip the ceremony to attend a reptile convention, where he got their sons with sons Rocco, 9, and Rafael, 8, a new lizard.Jamie McCarthy/WireImage"He couldn't be here because we're getting a bearded dragon, and he went to a reptile expo in New Jersey," she quipped. "So, thank you, baby." Meanwhile, Bobby quipped that Rose, who he started dating around 2012, "destroyed my life with that announcement." "His name is Benny," the actor added of the family pet in a recent The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon appearance. "He's named after Benson Boone 'cause my son loves Benson Boone."Kevin Mazur/Getty ImagesWho else hit the red carpet at the Vanity Fair Oscars party?
